name: Yes or No Bets
description: Teacher asks a yes-or-no question. Everyone answers, then one by one the class bets on what each classmate said. Most correct guesses wins.

intro.message: The teacher will ask a yes-or-no question. Everyone answers honestly, then we go around guessing what each classmate said!

ask.prompt: Have you ever laughed at the WRONG moment — a serious assembly, a silent library, somebody's big speech?

transition.message: Time to bet! For each classmate, guess what they answered.

playTime: ~10–15 min (a betting round per classmate, capped at 10)
recommendedFor: Any time — works as an icebreaker or a quick read-the-room game. Question quality IS the game: pick one that's fun to guess AND safe to answer publicly (every answer gets revealed by name).
